simplemobs.guide.page.1.title: Simple Mobs
simplemobs.guide.page.1: New bosses and mobs with fair, announced attacks, their drops, the Blighted Wither and the Biome Brush.
simplemobs.guide.page.2.title: Hollow Howler
simplemobs.guide.page.2: A Deep Dark boss you summon yourself: build the figure, blow a goat horn near a sculk sensor in the dark, and it manifests within 5 seconds.
simplemobs.guide.page.3.title: Potion of Silence
simplemobs.guide.page.3: Warped Potion (Awkward Potion without SimpleLib) + Echo Core: 3:00 of Silence (redstone 8:00, splash and lingering as usual). Sculk sensors, Wardens and Howlers do not hear you, like wool.
simplemobs.guide.page.4.title: Shellker
simplemobs.guide.page.4: An End gateway guard: a Shulker in a bedrock-hard shell. Four of them sit beside every End gateway, disguised as bedrock, until you come close.
simplemobs.guide.page.5.title: High Gravity and the Shellker Helmet
simplemobs.guide.page.5: High Gravity pulls you down: jumps, Levitation and Elytra lift keep 10 % and falls hurt 50 % more per level (Feather Falling still helps). The Shellker Helmet makes you immune.
simplemobs.guide.page.6.title: Soulfire Blaze
simplemobs.guide.page.6: A Blaze of soul fire, found rarely in Soul Sand Valleys. Shoots volleys of soul fireballs and drops the Soulfire Rod.
simplemobs.guide.page.7.title: Deceiver: cloak, disguise, mirror
simplemobs.guide.page.7: From Deceiver Cloth: a cloak that lets you take any mob's or player's shape, a particle-free invisibility potion and a mirror that sees through deceptions.
simplemobs.guide.page.8.title: Deceiver: cloak, disguise, mirror
simplemobs.guide.page.8: The Deceiver itself has double life, takes the hit box of the mob it imitates and can double its summons.
simplemobs.guide.page.9.title: Dread
simplemobs.guide.page.9: A fear mob you build yourself: a 2.6 block knight of rusted armor with soul flames in its empty helmet and a chain mace. Its Shivering aura makes your aim waver; bright light weakens it.
simplemobs.guide.page.10.title: Hollow Watcher
simplemobs.guide.page.10: A 4 block shadow with many eyes on the outer End islands. It moves only while nobody looks at it; a spyglass look freezes it. Unwatched it teleports behind you and grips you.
simplemobs.guide.page.11.title: Shivering aura, Calm Amulet and Focus
simplemobs.guide.page.11: Near a fear mob you shiver: your aim wavers. Shivering I to V by distance (V under 4 blocks)
simplemobs.guide.page.12.title: Shivering aura, Calm Amulet and Focus
simplemobs.guide.page.12: while it looks at you or is triggered. The Calm Amulet or the Potion of Focus makes you immune.
simplemobs.guide.page.13.title: Blighted Wither, Nether Heart and Red Nether Gem
simplemobs.guide.page.14.title: Blighted Wither, Nether Heart and Red Nether Gem
simplemobs.guide.page.14: put a Netherite Helmet on the middle skull of the Wither figure before the third skull and the
simplemobs.guide.page.15.title: Blighted Wither, Nether Heart and Red Nether Gem
simplemobs.guide.page.15: Blighted Wither rises - 600 health, armor 8, three phases, and every special attack is announced before it
simplemobs.guide.page.16.title: Blighted Wither, Nether Heart and Red Nether Gem
simplemobs.guide.page.16: hits. An Enderite Helmet calls the even stronger Abyssal Wither. Both drop a Nether Heart, the Abyssal Wither also a Red Nether Gem.
simplemobs.guide.page.17.title: First pickup tips
simplemobs.guide.page.17: The first time you pick up a machine or tool whose use is not obvious, one short tip shows in the action bar - once per player and world.
simplemobs.guide.page.18.title: Creative tabs
simplemobs.guide.page.18: The module's items sit in its own creative tab and are also sorted into the fitting Vanilla tabs and the search tab.
